ops.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. REGULATION (most material): EU — the European Parliament APPROVED the AI Act 'Digital Omnibus' simplification on 16 June 2026; formal adoption is expected before the 2 Aug trigger. High-risk Annex deadlines stay deferred (Annex III 2 Dec 2027, Annex I 2 Aug 2028), but the grace period for transparency labelling of AI-generated content was cut from 6 to 3 months — now due 2 Dec 2026; worth noting only if generated-content disclosure ever touches the agent-facing API. COLORADO (CORRECTION to the prior scan): the AI Act did NOT take effect 30 June — SB 189 (signed 14 May 2026) repealed-and-replaced it, pushing the effective date to 1 Jan 2027 and narrowing it to disclosure/transparency duties. AUSTRALIA: no new binding obligation on private companies; the National AI Plan keeps mandatory guardrails shelved for a technology-neutral approach. Watch the APP 1.7–1.9 transparency duties for automated decisions using personal info, effective 10 Dec 2026. FUNDING: Q1 2026 stayed barbell-shaped — late-stage absorbed roughly 82% of capital; seed dollars rose ~31% YoY but deal count fell ~30% (larger checks, fewer companies) — a structural headwind for an unconnected, bootstrapped solo founder. SOLO-FOUNDER ECONOMICS: full agent stacks are now cited at ~$300–500/month; ops and async commentary keep stressing GOVERNED systems with audit trails and human checkpoints (congruent with Sage Ops + R5/R16). RISKS — FOUNDER ATTENTION: EU transparency deadline 2 Dec 2026; AU APP 1.7–1.9 10 Dec 2026; Colorado now 1 Jan 2027 (eases near-term pressure). OPPORTUNITY: the cheap, governed agent stack remains a near-zero-marginal-cost lift for the founder's own tooling.

growth.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. ANTHROPIC ECOSYSTEM (most material): Anthropic shipped an in-app plugin/connector DIRECTORY submission flow plus observability (public beta, June 2026) — owners can submit MCP connectors directly inside Claude and track adoption, directory rank, errors and latency across Claude / Claude Code / Cowork. This is the single most actionable item: it strengthens the PR15 Anthropic-native posture and gives the sage-* skills/connectors a first-party distribution-plus-metrics path, not only third-party marketplaces. VERTICAL BUNDLES: Anthropic is pushing domain-specific plugin suites (e.g. ~12 legal plugins + ~20 MCP connectors, on Opus 4.8) — the official ecosystem is maturing from horizontal dev tools toward vertical packaging; a reasoning/certification 'category' plausibly fits that pattern. AX/DEVREL: 'Agent Experience as the first customer touchpoint' has hardened into 2026 consensus (Stainless, Nordic APIs), with 'agent SEO' emerging — validating the API-first/AX posture as on-trend rather than niche. COMPETITORS / THREATS: honesty-under-pressure evaluation is consolidating around established benchmarks (MASK, SafePro, task-abandonment honesty) — adjacent to the Sage Assent honesty/character claim and liable to crowd the framing; MCP/skill supply-chain security (poisoned configs, malicious marketplace skills) remains the dominant trust differentiator, so a certification entrant is judged on security credibility first. The recurring 'Silicon Valley misreads Stoicism' critique (NPR, Apr 2026) is a persistent brand-confusion risk for any tech-Stoic positioning. OPPORTUNITY: Stoicon 2026 (17 Oct; tickets open 1 July) is a fixed community anchor; the honesty-benchmark gap — models accurate yet dishonest under pressure — leaves room for a character/virtue trust framing distinct from pure red-team evals.

support.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. REGULATION (most material): TENNESSEE SB 1580 is confirmed effective 1 July 2026 — it bars representing AI as a 'qualified mental health professional'; breaches are deceptive-trade-practice offences (~$5,000/violation) PLUS a private right of action. Directly reinforces R18a honest positioning (never certify or imply licensed clinical capacity). COLORADO (CORRECTION to the prior scan): the AI Act did NOT land 30 June — SB 189 (signed 14 May 2026) delayed it to 1 Jan 2027 and narrowed it to disclosure/transparency; a federal magistrate also stayed enforcement (27 Apr). The disclosure + crisis-referral + 'not a licensed professional' compliance FLOOR keeps consolidating across CA SB 243 (live Jan 2026), Oregon SB 1546, New York, the Illinois WOPR Act (live 4 Aug 2025; $10k/violation) and Nevada AB 406 (live 1 Jul 2025) — Illinois and Nevada outright BAN AI-delivered therapy, so the standing awareness is to stay positioned as a reflection tool, never therapy (R18a/R19/R20). EVIDENCE: fresh sycophancy research (Science journal, 2026; Stanford, Mar 2026) finds flattering AI raises users' conviction they are right and cuts willingness to apologise — strong external validation of the R19 mirror principle / anti-sycophancy posture. ACCESSIBILITY: a WCAG 3.0 Editor's Draft was published 19 June 2026 (~174 outcome-based requirements; graded Bronze/Silver), but W3C Recommendation is now 'not before 2029' — WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA remains the live legal standard and SageReasoning's target; no change. RISK — FOUNDER ATTENTION: the 'not a licensed professional' + crisis-referral floor (TN 1 July) is the live compliance signal for human-facing tools. OPPORTUNITY: souring public/Gen Z AI sentiment (Stanford AI Index 2026; Gen Z 'excited' 36% to 22%) favours an honest, anti-sycophancy, safety-first stance.
